title: Core chart-square verification for one glued chart
statement: Under the local cartesian square, open immersion, over-map compatibility, chart commutativity, and inverse-image equality q₀⁻¹(range(jᵢ)) = Uᵢ, the chart cone is a limit cone. The inverse-image equality is essential.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.isPullback to the commuting square, using Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι and the inverse-image equality. Extract the limit cone with IsPullback.isLimit'.

lean.statement:
theorem glued_model_chart_pullback_core
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {V : Over X}
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens) (W : I → Over Y)
    (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left) (i : I)
    (hcart : IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hopen : IsOpenImmersion (j i))
    (hover : j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom)
    (hcomm : q i ≫ j i = (U i).ι ≫ q₀)
    (hpreimage : q₀ ⁻¹ᵁ (j i).opensRange = U i) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk (q i) (U i).ι hcomm))
